meta.name: folklore-variant-evidence
meta.description: Retrieve ClinGen gene-disease validity assertions for a public gene or disease, and review source-linked public evidence and literature for one supported GRCh38 germline nuclear SNV or simple indel through Folklore Clinical Variant Interpretation MCP. Use when a scientific agent must branch deterministically on resolved, ambiguous, not-found, invalid, unsupported, or unavailable variant outcomes; chain a resolved public variant into related literature or publication details; or preserve evidence provenance without accepting patient, phenotype, family, segregation, or private case data.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询基因与疾病的 ClinGen 证据,核对变异相关文献出处
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在遗传变异解读中需要核对公开证据与文献来源。
copy.tagline_en: Look up ClinGen gene-disease assertions and trace the literature behind a variant
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify public evidence and sources while interpreting genetic variants.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可通过 Folklore MCP 用公开标识符查询单个 GRCh38 胚系核 SNV 或简单 indel 的结构化证据、ACMG/AMP 变异级决策支持和来源文献，还能按基因或疾病查 ClinGen 基因-疾病有效性断言。
howto.when: 当你要查单个公开变异的证据、把已解析变异串到文献，或查基因-疾病关联时触发；要求 GRCh38 与胚系核 SNV 或简单 indel，不接受患者、表型、家系等私有数据。

say.text: 用 GRCh38 查一下 rs80357914 的公开变异证据
say.note: 若返回 ambiguous，会列出候选并停下等你手动选定

say.text: 把这个已解析变异的 canonical_key 串到相关文献
say.note: 会检索文献并标出每条结果的匹配类型

say.text: 查一下 BRCA1 的 ClinGen 基因-疾病有效性断言
say.note: 返回疾病身份、遗传方式与来源链接

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can look up structured evidence for one public GRCh38 germline SNV or simple indel via Folklore MCP: ACMG/AMP variant-level decision support, source links, linked literature, and ClinGen gene-disease assertions.
howto.when_en: Use when you need evidence for one public variant, chain a resolved variant into literature, or check gene-disease assertions. Requires GRCh38 germline nuclear SNV or simple indel; patient and family data are refused.

say_en.text: Look up the public variant evidence for rs80357914 under GRCh38
say_en.note: If ambiguous, it lists candidates and stops for your selection

say_en.text: Chain this resolved variant's canonical_key into related literature
say_en.note: It searches literature and labels each match type

say_en.text: Check the ClinGen gene-disease validity assertion for BRCA1
say_en.note: Returns disease identity, inheritance and source links
